central-colour.permission: Central colour reference or explicitly adopted named utility; no literal substitutes

central-colour-assignment.permission: Every assigned colour, conditional branch and fallback must resolve to an existing global colour token; runtime values remain flagged

central-typography.permission: Central named font/type utility or property-compatible central reference

central-radius.permission: Central radius token or adopted named utility when a radius family exists

central-shadow.permission: Central shadow token or exported recipe when a shadow family exists

component-chrome.permission: Use supported component props; protected consumer slots cannot restyle owned chrome

modal-field.permission: Directly recognized labeled fields in ChipModalBody use ChipModalField

icon-slot.permission: Registered field icon slots own geometry; no universal icon size is inferred

central-definition.permission: Review the intended system change with the engineer; record intentional changes or exceptions in the PR and involve the designer for new standards or ambiguous broad impact

central-artwork.permission: Reuse central EMCN artwork; introduce or change shared artwork with an explicit design-system review. Provider branding and user media remain exempt.

control-redundant-style.permission: Remove only exact repeats proven redundant against every resolved active central recipe and the reviewed class merger

control-accessible-name.permission: Name proven icon-only buttons with existing action text; dynamic names and content require review

control-duplicate-artwork.permission: Reuse identical static central drawings while preserving caller size, paint and accessibility

branding.integration: Literal Sim BlockConfig tools bgColor is an established data input, not an ordinary colour token

notes: User policy permits any approved semantic choice; do not infer text roles from wording.
No universal spacing, icon size, or complete Tailwind palette approval is implied.
Built-in utility names are explicitly adopted by the central styling guidance; their values come from pinned Tailwind tooling.

adoption.namedUtilities: Only named utilities directly referenced in central styling definitions or explicitly listed builtins; no application occurrence or arbitrary numeric literal grants permission.
adoption.fontWeights: Explicit documented normal/medium/semibold policy overrides observed historical component debt.

artwork.permission: Reuse central EMCN artwork; introduce or change shared artwork with an explicit design-system review. Provider branding and user media remain exempt.

packages/emcn/src/icons/linkedin.tsx.reason: Third-party LinkedIn provider glyph; product icon geometry remains governed separately

apps/sim/app/_shell/consent/consent-pref.reason: Consent link presentation belongs exclusively to the landing shell; product reuse requires removing this declaration.
